name: Spinner
description: An in-progress indicator drawn as moving water, in three variants and five sizes.

props.name: variant
props.description: Ring: an arc with a fainter trail turning once every 0.8s. Drops: three dots that swell and sink in turn. Orbit: a droplet circling with a fading tail.

props.name: label
props.description: Text for screen readers. The spinner has role="status".

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. The colour is currentColor, water by default; pass text-current to adopt the surrounding text colour.
